Constraints: no text, writing, lettering, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, arrows, card borders or frames. No horror, gore or scary creatures.

It must still clearly read as a sweet white rabbit. Thin scratchy black contours and scribbled details, pink and green textured crayon patches. Arch, bunny and flowers fully within the right vignette and comfortably away from the image edges.
